svg.title: CoDiRe architecture and learning interfaces
svg.desc: A six-stage diagram showing source images encoded by a shared backbone, masked feature recombination, frozen compatibility filtering, detached donor optimization, a shared factual and candidate prediction path, and the student objective. Deployment retains only the backbone, mask, and classifier.
